fix.summary: HEAD d9351c5 is not Apply-converged. The two reproduced defects are repaired (FIFO admission now opens nonblocking before descriptor stat; optional callId is validated), all current gates pass, and rejected timeout/retry/environment/style/dependency proposals remain absent. However, several exact production-proof obligations from the accepted authority are still missing, and the lifecycle repair added test-only production hooks. Complete only the OPEN classes below; do not add locks, timeouts, retries, schedulers, parallel trackers, or test-only production hooks.

classes.name: LifecycleAdmissionExclusion
classes.owner: Assisted Runner append-only lifecycle admission seam
classes.boundary: Ended, active-call, Navigator-settlement, and role-reservation admission remain mutually exclusive under races.
classes.disposition: OPEN. Tests use the new AssistedRunnerDependenciesV1.afterLedgerEvent production hook solely as a crash probe, contrary to the no-test-only-production-hook Apply rule. Remove that hook and prove the call_started-before-Navigator, Navigator-settlement-versus-reservation, and end-versus-call barriers through an owned production seam, including no loser child launch or post-ended generation.

classes.name: EvidenceAdmissionContainment
classes.owner: Assisted evidence admission and Navigator loader seam
classes.boundary: Regular descriptor reads, immutable bytes, unique IDs, and capability-contained handles are enforced.
classes.disposition: OPEN. FIFO/device/oversize, ID/path, file mutation, and [REDACTED] rejection are covered, but the authorized descriptor-race proof is absent; the prior post-admission Uint8Array mutation proof was replaced by file mutation; and valid package-generated versus declared absolute-handle capability behavior is not proved at the production loader seam. Add those exact regressions without timeout logic.

classes.name: SelectedSettlementEvidenceTruth
classes.owner: Recorder settlement to post-settlement acquisition seam
classes.boundary: Every selected terminal outcome reaches the post-settlement Navigator as exactly one authentic artifact.
classes.disposition: OPEN. The new tests classify accepted role outcomes and separately call acquisition for failure/recovery, but never activate the post-settlement Navigator with those artifacts. Prove converged, continue, escalation, refusal, infrastructure, and recovered outcomes in actual post-settlement Navigator input, with exact artifact identity and pre/post distinction.

classes.boundary: All manifest, receipt, session, identity, length, digest, and child outcome joins gate settlement.
classes.disposition: OPEN. The join mutation loop is broader, but no child submits a valid receipt and then exits nonzero or receives a signal. Add both real Recorder child cases and verify live plus recovery preserve exact infrastructure/cancellation truth and never accept the role or Navigator outcome.

classes.name: RecoveryStateContinuity
classes.owner: Assisted Runner reservation and same-call replay seam
classes.boundary: Reservation, recovered publication, and settled post-navigation replay preserve one selected identity and durable pre/post truth.
classes.disposition: OPEN. Crash tests depend on afterLedgerEvent, a test-only production hook, and assert only non-null receipts. Replace the hook with owned-seam barriers and prove exact pre/post receipt identities, durable latestAttempt across later calls, no duplicate selected launch, and no duplicate post-consultation.

classes.name: LedgerTemporaryPublicationSafety
classes.boundary: Peer temporaries survive, true losers are typed, and cleanup failure preserves both causes.
classes.disposition: OPEN. The test creates an arbitrary peer temp rather than holding an appender at its real temporary-publication seam, and production now exports optional rename/cleanup callbacks used only by the test. Remove the test-only I/O API and use an owned filesystem seam/barrier to prove a live peer temp, canonical winner, typed loser, and primary-plus-cleanup causality.

classes.name: EvidencePagingCoverage
classes.owner: Navigator evidence reader and sealed reconstruction seam

classes.disposition: OPEN. The matrix compares NavigatorEvidenceStore directly with exported sealedEvidenceReads; it does not traverse createRecorderAssistedTransportV1.readSealed as required. Add the empty/adjacent/overlap/sparse/failed-decode/large matrix through the real recovery surface without a second tracker.

classes.boundary: Recorded receipts are closed, identity-bound, variant-correct, and citation-valid.
classes.disposition: OPEN. Recorder coverage adds only extra, runId binding, status/primary mismatch, and one unknown refused defect citation. It still omits malformed UUIDv7, digest, cursor, subject, latestAttempt, explanation, primary required-field variants, and unread/top-level-disagreeing refused defect evidenceId cases through both extraction and recovery.

The TS/CLI matrix also omits malformed recovery IDs, zero/negative parent and child variants, duplicate/illegal/overlapping unset variants, enter/resume traversal/coercible paths, and explicit ledger/spawn no-side-effect oracles.

classes.disposition: OPEN. Value.Check exercises workspace source schemas and a cache-busted ../dist import, not a packed and cold-installed package. Add the cold npm-package consumer path and the missing required-field/nested-extra/cross-variant behavioral matrix.
